entities.summary: Green Movement, a transformative movement in Iran (2002–2015). Emerged from President Khatami and Reconstruction and Reform Era. Catalyzed JCPOA nuclear agreement signed between Iran and P5+1 and Green Movement protests erupt after disputed presidential election.
